title: The Shining
about: A writer takes a winter job as caretaker of an empty mountain hotel with his wife and son.

    StartersOverlook storeroom antipasto boardWarm orange olives, salami, provolone, pickles, artichokes and grissiniHow to make it250g mixed olives60ml olive oil1 orange, peel in strips1 garlic clove, sliced1/2 tsp chilli flakes150g salami150g provolone200g giardiniera pickled vegetables100g marinated artichokes1 packet grissini8 cornichonsWarm the olives in the oil with orange peel, garlic and chilli flakes, then cool.Slice the salami and provolone.Arrange on a big board in tidy rows with the olives, giardiniera, artichokes, grissini and cornichons.Serve at room temperature.Gold Room spiced nutsMixed nuts roasted with rosemary, brown sugar, butter and cayenneHow to make it400g mixed unsalted nuts30g butter, melted2 tbsp brown sugar1 tbsp rosemary, chopped1 tsp sea salt flakes1/4 tsp cayenne pepperToss the nuts with the butter, sugar, rosemary, salt and cayenne.Spread on a lined tray and roast at 180°C, stirring halfway.Cool so the coating sets.Serve warm in small bowls.Hedge maze herb crackers and whipped fetaThe hedge maze outside, under the snowHow to make itAs written, serves 4Parmesan and herb crackers scored with a maze pattern and studded with rosemary and parsley, with a snowy whipped feta dip.Rub 80g cold butter into 150g plain flour, 40g grated parmesan, 1 tbsp chopped rosemary, 1 tbsp chopped parsley and half a tsp salt, then add 2 to 3 tbsp cold water to bring it together.Chill 20 minutes, roll 3mm thick between baking paper and cut into squares.Score a maze into each with a knife.Bake at 180°C for 12 minutes.Whip 150g feta with 100g Greek yoghurt and lemon zest.Prawn cocktail with Marie Rose sauceAll work and no play. Have one.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsHallorann's roast leg of lambGarlic and rosemary studded lamb leg with roast potatoes and pan gravyHow to make it2kg lamb leg4 garlic cloves, sliced4 rosemary sprigs2 tbsp olive oil1 tsp salt1/2 tsp pepper1kg potatoes, quartered1 tbsp plain flour300ml beef stockStud the lamb with garlic and rosemary and rub with oil, salt and pepper.Roast at 200°C with the potatoes around it.Rest.Stir the flour into the pan juices, add the stock and simmer for gravy.Carve and serve.Wendy's breakfast in bed trayThe tray Wendy takes up to JackHow to make itAs written, serves 4Soft buttery scrambled eggs on sourdough with crisp bacon, grilled tomato and mushrooms, fresh orange juice and a pot of coffee, all on one tray.Fry 8 rashers bacon until crisp.Halve 4 tomatoes and grill 6 minutes.Sauté 250g mushrooms in 20g butter.Whisk 8 eggs with 60ml cream and salt and cook over low heat in 30g butter, stirring slowly, for 4 to 5 minutes until just set.Toast 4 slices sourdough.Plate on trays with a glass of fresh orange juice squeezed from 6 oranges and a pot of coffee.SweetsHallorann's chocolate ice creamChocolate it shall be. Dark custard ice cream.How to make it400ml thickened cream300ml full cream milk150g dark chocolate2 tbsp cocoa5 egg yolks120g caster sugarWarm the cream, milk, chocolate and cocoa until melted.Whisk the yolks with the sugar.Pour the warm mix over, return to the pan and cook, stirring, to 82°C.Chill overnight.Churn, or freeze and stir every 30 minutes.DrinksLloyd's bourbon old fashionedBourbon, demerara syrup and bitters stirred over a big ice block, orange peelHow to make it240ml bourbon40ml demerara sugar syrup8 dashes of aromatic bitters1 orange4 large ice blocks2 cups iceFor each drink, measure 60ml bourbon, 10ml demerara sugar syrup and 2 dashes aromatic bitters into a mixing glass.Stir each drink with ice in a mixing glass for 20 seconds.Strain into a rocks glass over one large ice block.Squeeze a strip of orange peel over the top and drop it in.Advocaat on ice with nutmegGrady spilled one on Jack in the Gold Room.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
